selection.disclosure: Exactly the four complete forms already illustrated in GDT1308 REPORT, selected for post-result explanation. All three readers and both A/B cells retained including absent cells, negative/zero contributions and rare cells. Not selected to maximize GDT1389 gain.

formulas.MIX_word_given_bag: M(w)/((P_B+Q_B)/2); if empty TRAIN cell use M=P
formulas.gain_decomposition: raw log(M/P) = bag log(M_B/P_B) + conditional-order log((M/M_B)/(P/P_B))
formulas.aggregation: Each row reports the common frozen per-occurrence score for its exact reader/Currier/length cell; sums are descriptive unweighted sums, NOT the experiment equal-leaf primary score.

limits: Exact whole unit tuples only; embedded strings and alternate readers are not pooled.
Every matching held occurrence ID retained. Zero-held cells are explicit missing illustrations, not evidence of impossibility.
Small daldy TRAIN/EVAL counts remain weak illustrative support; no independent significance or global frequency claim.
P(w|bag) and MIX(w|bag) condition on every full-support distinct permutation, not only attested orders.
The conditional mixture is formed AFTER mixing; it is not a50:50 mixture of separately normalized conditional laws.
The four illustrations cannot replace the full frozen aggregate decision or imply significance, meaning, lexical roles, cipher recovery or a historical writer.
